name: Ethiopia Roast
promptName: Stand-Up Kraft Coffee Pouch with Degassing Valve
legacyNames: Stand-Up Kraft Coffee Pouch with Degassing Valve
description: A stand-up matte kraft-paper laminate coffee pouch with a foil-lined zip closure and a round plastic one-way degassing valve, filled with whole roasted coffee beans.
materials: matte kraft-paper laminate pouch with a gusseted base; foil-lined zip-lock closure strip; round black plastic degassing valve; whole roasted coffee beans
primaryColors: kraft brown (pouch), natural bean tan (coffee beans)
negativeConstraints: Never render any text, logo, printing, or embossed lettering on the kraft pouch; keep the zip closure and degassing valve plain and unbranded at every angle. Exception: a mark, wordmark, or label that the brief's art direction explicitly names is deliberate and must be rendered exactly as directed — the text bans above apply only to invented marks the art direction never asked for.
preservationNotes: Maintain the same pouch silhouette, gusseted base shape, valve placement, kraft brown color, and bean tan color consistent across all four angles.
